title: Tech Baliye
description: Tech Baliye was a one-of-a-kind techno-cultural extravaganza organized collaboratively by TechShuttle × BVPCSI × Aura. The event integrated technology, dance, and innovation under one stage, demonstrating the creative synergy between technology and art. From Code & Choreo Showdown to the Grand Fusion finale themed 'The Pulse of Innovation' — participants showcased not just their artistic flair but also their technological insight, turning code into choreography and logic into rhythm.
agenda: Round 1 – Tech Quiz Showdown: Fast-paced quiz testing technology and problem-solving
Round 2 – The Creative Crossover: Live dance performance by Aura blending rhythm with reason
Round 3 – Online Challenge: Advanced concepts and real-world tech applications
Round 4 – The Buzzer Battle: Speed, accuracy, and teamwork competition

title: CodeSpirit: PyLaunch
description: CodeSpirit: PyLaunch was an interactive workshop designed to introduce participants to Python-based data science fundamentals. The session bridged the gap between theoretical knowledge and real-world application by familiarizing students with widely used Python libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn. Through hands-on demonstrations and guided practice, participants explored data-driven problem-solving and developed confidence in using Python as a tool for analytics and technology-driven projects.
agenda: Introduction to Python for Data Science
NumPy: Arrays and numerical computing basics

title: Code Golfing
description: Code Golfing challenged participants to solve Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) problems using the least number of characters possible, emphasizing code efficiency and logic minimalism over verbosity. Hosted on the HackerRank platform, the event improved creative problem-solving and introduced students to writing clean, concise and optimized code. It encouraged participants to think beyond traditional methods and approach problems from a fresh, innovative perspective, blending speed, logic, and mastery of syntax into one high-intensity session.
agenda: DSA problems with character limit constraints

title: TechTussle
description: TechTussle was a challenging and interactive problem-solving competition based on Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA). The event tested participants' logical thinking and real-time performance under pressure through a dynamic two-round format. The quiz round reinforced core theoretical concepts, while the buzzer round challenged participants to think critically and act swiftly, enhancing both decision-making and problem-solving speed.
agenda: Round 1 – Quiz Round: DSA & AI theoretical concepts
Round 2 – Buzzer Round: Real-time problem solving under pressure

title: Quantitative Aptitude is NOT just Math!
description: An engaging and interactive masterclass designed to help students master smart problem-solving techniques for placements and competitive exams. Led by Mr. Sharad Awasthi, an esteemed IIT BHU & IIM Lucknow alumnus and VP Academics at CL Educate, students learned strategic thinking, logical reasoning, and efficient problem-solving beyond traditional mathematical calculations. The session demystified aptitude and equipped students with confidence for CAT, GRE, GMAT, and campus placements.
speakers: Mr. Sharad Awasthi (IIT BHU & IIM Lucknow, VP Academics - CL Educate)
agenda: Shortcuts and techniques for competitive exams

title: Game of Code 2.0
description: Game of Code 2.0 engaged participants in a challenging and interactive problem-solving competition. Participants played a Jumble Code round followed by matching outputs for given code. The event tested logical thinking, teamwork, and cryptographic skills as teams worked together to decipher problems. The ultimate goal was to create a fun, educational, and competitive environment where participants applied their analytical abilities in real-time scenarios.

title: Break The Password
description: Break The Password engaged participants in a challenging and interactive problem-solving competition designed to test logical thinking, teamwork, and cryptographic skills. Participants worked together to decipher given passwords under time pressure. The event promoted technology innovation, education, and knowledge sharing while creating a fun and competitive environment where analytical abilities were applied in real-time scenarios.
